## Design

### 2026-10-09 – I started the schematic for my starbie. I am going to call it sunbie and make it shaped like the sun. Instead of using the MPU-6050 breakout board, I opted to use the bare chip. I will probably also a

**2h**

I started the schematic for my starbie. I am going to call it sunbie and make it shaped like the sun. Instead of using the MPU-6050 breakout board, I opted to use the bare chip. I will probably also add some type of light sensor so it could maybe sleep at night and maybe replace the dht11 with a bme280 so i can get altitued and show cool animations when going up or down things

### 2026-10-09 – I added a light sensor using the TSL25911FN. I want to make this double as a cool alarm clock  that goes to sleep when it's dark inside if possible and just be really funny to carry around. I will pro

**2h**

I added a light sensor using the TSL25911FN. I want to make this double as a cool alarm clock  that goes to sleep when it's dark inside if possible and just be really funny to carry around. I will probably use the light sensor to trigger cool animations. I also replaced the MPU-6050 with a significantly cheaper 6 Axis IMU, the LSM6DS3. I organized my schematic and added Test points so i could solder in a battery or other devices.

### 2026-10-10 – I layed out and routed the PCB. I also organized the Schematic. I placed one button on each side of the circle and one button in the circle.  To make sure my BMP280 doesnt end up measuring heat from t

**2h**

I layed out and routed the PCB. I also organized the Schematic. I placed one button on each side of the circle and one button in the circle.  To make sure my BMP280 doesnt end up measuring heat from the xiao I put them on opposite sides of the PCB. I forgot if I put this in my last entry but i added a passive buzzer that can make sound so my Sunbie can buzz and make cool noises
